question: 2002 年 9 月的门店退货率是多少？口径：门店退货率（%）= 期间内售出的门店销售行所对应的退货金额（sr_return_amt）之和 ÷ 这些销售行的净支付额（ss_net_paid）之和 × 100；按销售日期归属期间，退货按小票号和商品与销售行对应，每笔退货只计一次。保留两位小数。

run.sql:
WITH sep_sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
),
den AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS denom FROM sep_sales),
num AS (
  SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS numer
  FROM sep_sales f
  JOIN store_returns sr
    ON f.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
   AND f.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
)
SELECT ROUND(num.numer / den.denom * 100, 2) AS return_rate,
       num.numer, den.denom
FROM num, den
